thread:
morgan_support: Customer on Private (collector v1.18) reports debug-bundle upload intermittently stalling during multipart PUTs. Happens after a few chunks. They see presign URL returned (200) but the PUT hangs and eventually times out. upload_id=up_abcd1234 request_id=REQ-20260301-7788
collector-bot: bundle_attempt=2026-03-01T14:02:05Z size=1.2GiB parts=0->waiting
eli_sre: can you paste the exact curl repro you used for the presign? also need the collector logs around the upload_id above
morgan_support: here's the quick repro I asked customer to try (replace <PRESIGN_URL> and <FILE>):
```
# try uploading one chunk to the presigned url (PUT)
curl -v -T ./sample-part.bin -H "Content-Type: application/octet-stream" -H "x-amz-acl: private" "<PRESIGN_URL>" --max-time 120
```

morgan_support: customer run that and it shows 100% bytes sent then connection stalls, curl eventually reports "Recv failure: Connection was reset". They said it sometimes completes if they retry 3-4x quickly.

june_oncall: do we have any signs of S3 region mismatch or NAT gateway dropping? ask them for tcpdump on host while they reproduce: sudo tcpdump -i eth0 port 443 -w /tmp/collector-upload.pcap (10s during repro)
eli_sre: also want the collector invocation they used to generate the bundle. if they ran with --upload we can ask for --no-upload + --trace output to inspect redaction step separately
morgan_support: customer supplied these collector logs (anonymized):
```
2026-03-01T13:59:58Z INFO  collector: starting bundle generation id=up_abcd1234
2026-03-01T14:02:07Z WARN  uploader: multipart part 3 upload stalled after 2 retries, retrying (backoff=4s)
2026-03-01T14:02:16Z WARN  uploader: multipart part 3 upload stalled after 3 retries
2026-03-01T14:02:24Z ERROR uploader: multipart upload failed: context deadline exceeded
2026-03-01T14:02:24Z ERROR redact: redaction process timed out after 45s, continuing without final pass
2026-03-01T14:02:25Z ERROR manifest: checksum mismatch expected=5d41402abc4b2a76b9719d911017c592 actual=5d41402abc4b2a76b9719d911017c591
```

morgan_support: note the checksum difference (last nibble). They see the same on retries sometimes matching, sometimes not.
devex_lina: checksum flip can indicate in-transit truncation or a streaming bug. two quick checks: 1) ask them to md5sum the file locally before curl and after the collector writes the part (if possible) 2) try increasing multipart chunk size to 16MB so fewer parts are uploaded
eli_sre: can you send the collector config snippet (storage/uploader section)? also need the presign URL expiry and signing service (we've seen issues when presign TTL < time drift).
morgan_support: customer says presign TTL=15m, collector config snippet: 
```
uploader:
  mode: presign
  presign_endpoint: https://presign.prod.internal.example.com
  part_size_bytes: 8388608 # 8MB
  max_retries: 3
  region: us-west-2
```

june_oncall: region and presign endpoint look plausible. try asking them to bump part_size_bytes to 16777216 and max_retries to 8 for a short test. also confirm system clock: date && ntpstat
eli_sre: if presign is intermittently failing after some chunks, could be a proxy/NAT session timeout cutting TLS. tcpdump will show if we see TCP RST from gateway. tell customer to capture pcap and upload to usafe link or attach to debug bundle (if they can get the bundle uploaded).
morgan_support: repro steps I want customer to run and attach outputs: 
1) re-run bundle with no-upload + trace: `./collector generate-bundle --output /tmp/bundle.tar.gz --no-upload --trace`
2) md5sum /tmp/bundle.tar.gz and provide checksum
3) attempt manual upload to presign URL: `curl -v -T /tmp/bundle.part -H "Content-Type: application/octet-stream" "<PRESIGN_PART_URL>" --max-time 120` (capture verbose log)
4) capture tcpdump during manual upload and attach pcap
5) collector logs (journalctl -u collector.service -n 200)

collector-bot: reminder: redact tool version in bundle should be included under /opt/collector/redact/version.txt

devex_lina: if they can't get presign to work, fallback option: run with `--upload-mode direct-s3` and provide temporary STS creds (short-lived). we can then attempt server-side upload and rule out presign/proxy.
eli_sre: also capture the S3 response headers when curl fails (curl -v shows them). request_id from S3 (x-amz-request-id) will help. can they attach that?
morgan_support: customer provided one failing curl verbose snippet (sanitized):
```
* Connected to presign.prod.internal.example.com (10.20.30.40) port 443 (#0)
> PUT /upload/part/3?X-Amz-Algorithm=... HTTP/1.1
> Host: presign.prod.internal.example.com
> User-Agent: curl/7.68.0
> Accept: */*
> Content-Length: 8388608
> Expect: 100-continue
< HTTP/1.1 100 Continue
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
< x-amz-request-id: FXKJ9QWZ12Y3
< x-amz-id-2: abcdefghijklmnop
* We are completely uploaded and fine
* Received HTTP/1.1 200 OK
* Connection #0 to host presign.prod.internal.example.com left intact
# then hangs for ~30s and eventually: 
* Recv failure: Connection was reset
```

eli_sre: that pattern (200 then stall) suggests the presign service returned a 200 for an initial handshake then the backend S3 stream was interrupted. Getting the pcap + x-amz-request-id will let us correlate.
june_oncall: schedule: can the customer run the no-upload trace now? I'll be oncall for the next hour to help if they reproduce. @morgan_support please coordinate and paste links to artifacts here when available. :handshake:
morgan_support: will ask them to run now and will post bundle.md5, pcap and the trace logs. also asked them to try part_size_bytes=16777216 and max_retries=8. thanks all.
eli_sre: once we have pcap and x-amz-request-id, I'll escalate to infra to check NAT gateway and load balancer timeouts. also check presign service logs for the signing timestamp vs request timestamp to rule out clock skew.
collector-bot: note: if bundle contains PII, ensure upload is to the secure presign and mark ticket with #sensitive until redaction complete.
devex_lina: tip for future: include `--upload-verify` which runs a post-upload md5 verification (newer collector builds) — if customer is on older v1.18 it's not available, so checksum mismatch can be a symptom.
morgan_support: uploaded artifact links pending, will follow up when attachments arrive. :eyes:
